title: The Four Seasons and the Weather

vocabulary.meaning_en: one of the four parts of the year
vocabulary.example: There are four seasons in a year.
There are four seasons in a year.
It's rainy and cold in winter.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the season after winter, when flowers grow
vocabulary.example: It's windy and warm in spring.
It's hot and sunny in summer.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the season after summer, when leaves fall
vocabulary.note_ar: fall أشيع في أمريكا، و autumn أشيع في بريطانيا
vocabulary.note_en: "Fall" is American English; "autumn" is British English.
vocabulary.example: It's cloudy and cool in fall.

vocabulary.meaning_en: how hot, cold, rainy or windy it is outside
vocabulary.note_ar: غالبًا نضع قبلها the: the weather

vocabulary.example: I like the sound of rain.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the big star that gives us light
vocabulary.example: The sun is strong in summer.

vocabulary.note_ar: نكرر حرف n ثم نضيف y: sun → sunny
vocabulary.note_en: Double the n, then add y: sun → sunny.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a white or grey shape in the sky
vocabulary.example: There is a big cloud in the sky.
It's cloudy and cool in fall.

vocabulary.note_ar: مع اسم مفرد: comes (مضارع بسيط لأنها حقيقة)
vocabulary.note_en: With a singular noun: comes (present simple, because it's a fact).

vocabulary.meaning_en: the one you like the most
a word that joins two things

fine_lines.title: cold vs cool
fine_lines.explanation_ar: cold = بارد جدًا مثل الشتاء، أما cool = بارد قليلًا ومنعش.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Cold is very low in temperature; cool is only a little cold and pleasant.

examples.sentence: It's cold in winter. Wear a coat.
It's cool in the evening in fall.

fine_lines.title: hot vs warm
fine_lines.explanation_ar: hot = حار جدًا مثل الصيف، و warm = دافئ ولطيف مثل الربيع.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Hot is very high in temperature; warm is nicely hot.

fine_lines.title: before vs after
fine_lines.explanation_ar: before = قبل، و after = بعد. ترتيب الفصول: winter ثم spring ثم summer ثم fall.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Before means earlier; after means later. Order: winter, spring, summer, fall.

fine_lines.title: noun vs adjective: rain / rainy
fine_lines.explanation_ar: نضيف y للاسم فيصبح صفة للطقس: rain ← rainy، wind ← windy، cloud ← cloudy، و sun ← sunny مع تكرار n.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Add y to a weather noun to make an adjective: rain → rainy, wind → windy, cloud → cloudy, sun → sunny (double n).

expressions.example: What's the weather like today? It's sunny.

expressions.phrase: It's rainy and cold in winter.
expressions.example: It's rainy and cold in winter, so I stay at home.

expressions.phrase: It's windy and warm in spring.
expressions.example: It's windy and warm in spring.

expressions.phrase: It's hot and sunny in summer.
expressions.example: It's hot and sunny in summer. Let's go to the beach.

expressions.phrase: It's cloudy and cool in fall.
expressions.meaning_ar: الجو غائم ومائل للبرودة في الخريف.
expressions.example: It's cloudy and cool in fall.

expressions.phrase: There are four seasons in a year.
expressions.example: There are four seasons in a year: winter, spring, summer and fall.

expressions.meaning_en: Saying which season you like most.
expressions.example: I like cool weather. Fall is my favourite season.

expressions.meaning_en: Talking about the order of seasons.
expressions.example: Summer comes after spring and before fall.

grammar.title: It's + weather adjective
grammar.explanation_ar: للحديث عن الطقس نستخدم It's (اختصار It is)، لأن الطقس غير إنسان فنستخدم it. ثم نضيف صفة الطقس، ويمكن ربط صفتين بـ and وإضافة الفصل بـ in.
grammar.explanation_en: Use It's (It is) for weather, because weather is not a person. Add a weather adjective; join two with and; add the season with in.
examples: It's hot and sunny in summer.
It's windy and warm in spring.

grammar.title: Asking about the weather
grammar.explanation_ar: السؤال: What's the weather like? (ما حالة الطقس؟). يبدأ بحرف W كبير وينتهي بعلامة استفهام، والإجابة تبدأ بـ It's.
grammar.explanation_en: Ask: What's the weather like? Start with a capital W and end with a question mark. Answer with It's.
examples: What's the weather like? It's cloudy and cool.
What's the weather like in summer? It's hot.

grammar.title: Making weather adjectives with -y
grammar.explanation_ar: كثير من صفات الطقس تأتي من اسم + y: rain ← rainy، wind ← windy، cloud ← cloudy. في sun نكرر n: sunny.
grammar.explanation_en: Many weather adjectives are noun + y: rainy, windy, cloudy. For sun, double the n: sunny.

grammar.title: Facts about seasons: present simple with before / after
grammar.explanation_ar: ترتيب الفصول حقيقة ثابتة، فنستخدم المضارع البسيط. الفصل اسم مفرد (من أصحاب الـ s) فنقول comes. ونستخدم There are four seasons لأن seasons جمع.
grammar.explanation_en: The order of seasons is a fact, so use the present simple. A season is singular, so say comes. Use There are with the plural seasons.
examples: There are four seasons in a year.

questions.question: ___ the weather like?
questions.explanation_ar: السؤال عن الطقس: What's the weather like?
questions.explanation_en: We ask: What's the weather like?

questions.question: Summer comes ___ spring.
questions.explanation_en: Summer is later than spring, so after.

questions.question: There ___ four seasons in a year.
questions.explanation_en: Seasons is plural, so there are.

questions.question: Choose the correct spelling.
questions.explanation_ar: sun + y مع تكرار n: sunny.
questions.explanation_en: Double the n and add y: sunny.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation_ar: الخريف قبل الشتاء، و fall مفرد فنقول comes.
questions.explanation_en: Fall is before winter, and fall is singular, so comes.

questions.question: "Windy" means ___
questions.explanation_en: Windy comes from wind: with a lot of wind.
